status_summary: Public Law 119-21, approved 2025-07-04, lists Section 70331 on the base erosion minimum tax amount and Section 70601 on the excess business loss limitation. Law-firm summaries report that the base erosion tax rate is set permanently at 10.5 percent from 2026, instead of the 12.5 percent scheduled under prior law, and that the excess business loss limitation for noncorporate taxpayers was made permanent rather than expiring. Neither summary reports a change to the net investment income tax or to net operating loss carryforwards. The law retains the taxes the chapter asked to eliminate and keeps the loss limitation it asked to loosen.

timeline.event: Public Law 119-21 was approved; its table of contents lists Section 70331 on the base erosion minimum tax and Section 70601 on the excess business loss limitation.

title: Eliminate the net investment income surtax and the BEAT; raise business loss limit
uncertainties: Public Law 119-21 was read through U.S. Code amendment notes and two law-firm summaries; the enrolled text on GovInfo is truncated. The notes show the base erosion rate set at 10.5 percent (11.5 percent for bank and dealer groups) for taxable years after 2025, below the 12.5 percent scheduled under prior law, and the excess business loss limitation made permanent; whether its dollar amount changed was not stated. The Treasury Unified Agenda rule list on reginfo.gov (headed 'Agency Rule List - 2026') lists planned guidance implementing the 2025 base erosion amendments (1545-BR86), which keeps the tax, and no entry on the net investment income tax or loss limits. Checked systematically on 2026-10-19.
